front: What is the Store Sales task?
back: Forecast daily sales for 54 stores x 33 product families for the 16 days after the training data.
Square root of the mean of squared differences of log(1 + prediction) and log(1 + actual). Lower is better.

front: Which Store Sales features are known in the future?
back: onpromotion, the calendar, holidays, store attributes and oil prices (if the file covers the dates). Not sales or transactions.
Last 16 days of train as validation, fit on earlier days only, same length as the test.
All zeros, mean of the last 14 days per series, and seasonal naive (same weekday last week).

front: Why drop early zero rows of new stores?
back: Zeros before a store opened teach a wrong pattern. Removing them can help the model.
